items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: The diff implements the measured 11-of-22 fleet budget, integration outer-only policy, both synchronized race fixes, bounded progress, descendant cleanup, retained diagnostics, strict retries, coverage, and CI parity without unrelated behavior.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Spawn, timeout, cancellation, output-drain, evidence-write, and cleanup failures preserve a red/fault verdict; every supervisor exit reaps its owned tree and releases handle-owned resources.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Run, unit, phase, and child output are treated as untrusted: path keys are hashed, display text is capped, credential shapes are redacted, output is marked untrusted, and no secrets were added.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests assert observable process, lease, ordering, disk, retry, and CLI outcomes; planted scheduler mutations turned the synchronized overlap/FIFO tests red, and the native Windows probe uses real uv, pytest, xdist workers, an exited intermediate, and a grandchild.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: A fixed-size byte tail bounds pipe, memory, and disk; fleet replay selects weight 11 by four-run throughput and queue metrics, allowing two sibling F0s without exceeding capacity 22.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Process supervision, diagnostics, scheduling, and rendering remain in focused existing/new suite modules; every new source module is below the 300-line budget and names follow suite_* conventions.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Config-to-argv, supervisor-to-verdict, diagnostics-producer-to-disk-reader, and lifecycle-to-console boundaries are listed in the spec and pass real round trips. Diagnostic JSON is machine-produced, so export/comment/quote operator-input probes are n/a; invalid UTF-8, non-ASCII/control ids, long paths, duplicate writes, truncation, and redaction are covered.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py passed on every tracked and untracked changed Python test; the Windows-only Job Object skip carries the documented platform exception and POSIX cleanup has separate coverage.
